entries.title: Amos 5:1
segments: Hear this word which I take up against you, a dirge, O house of Israel.

entries.title: Amos 5:2
segments: The virgin of Israel has fallen; she shall rise no more; she lies forsaken on her land. There is none to raise her up.

entries.title: Amos 5:3
segments: For thus says the Lord Jehovah: The city that went out [by] a thousand shall leave a hundred, and that which went out [by] a hundred shall have ten left in the house of Israel.

entries.title: Amos 5:4
segments: For so says the LORD to the house of Israel: Seek Me, and you shall live.

entries.title: Amos 5:5
segments: But do not seek Bethel nor enter into Gilgal, and do not pass to Beer-sheba; for Gilgal shall surely go into exile, and Bethel shall come to nothing.

entries.title: Amos 5:6
segments: Seek the LORD, and you shall live; lest He break out like a fire [on] the house of Joseph and devour it, and there be none to put it out in Bethel.

entries.title: Amos 5:7
segments: You who turn judgment to wormwood and leave off righteousness [in] the earth,

entries.title: Amos 5:8
segments: seek Him who created the Pleiades and Orion, and who turned the deep darkness into the morning and He darkened the day [into] night. Seek Him who calls for the waters of the sea, and pours them out on the face of the earth; the LORD [ is] His name;

entries.title: Amos 5:9
segments: who causes destruction to flash out against the strong, and destruction comes against the fortress

entries.title: Amos 5:10
segments: They hate him who rebukes in the gate, and they despise him who speaks uprightly.

entries.title: Amos 5:11
segments: So, because of your trampling on the poor, and you take tribute of grain from him; you have built houses of carved stone, but you shall not dwell in them; you have planted desirable vineyards, but you shall not drink wine from them.

entries.title: Amos 5:12
segments: For I know your many transgressions and your many sins. They afflict the just, they take a bribe, and they turn aside the poor in the gate.

entries.title: Amos 5:13
segments: So the understanding ones shall keep silent in that time; for it [is] an evil time.

entries.title: Amos 5:14
segments: Seek good and not evil, that you may live; and so the LORD, the God of hosts, shall be with you, as you have spoken.

entries.title: Amos 5:15
segments: Hate the evil, and love the good, and establish judgment in the gate. It may be that the Lord Jehovah of hosts will be gracious [to] the remnant of Joseph.

entries.title: Amos 5:16
segments: So the LORD, the God of hosts, the Master, says this: Wailing [shall be] in all streets; and they shall say in all the highways, Alas! Alas! And they shall call the tiller to mourning, and those who are skillful in mourning to wailing.

entries.title: Amos 5:17
segments: And there [shall be] wailing in all vineyards; for I will pass through you, says the LORD.

entries.title: Amos 5:18
segments: Woe to those desiring the day of the LORD! What [is] this for you? The day of the LORD [is] darkness and not light;

entries.title: Amos 5:19
segments: as [if] a man fled from a lion, and a bear met him; or went into the house and leaned his hand on the wall, and a snake bit him.

entries.title: Amos 5:20
segments: [Shall] not the day of the LORD [be] darkness and not light? Even very dark, and no brightness in it?

entries.title: Amos 5:21
segments: I hate, I despise your feast days, and I will not delight in your solemn assemblies.

entries.title: Amos 5:22
segments: Though you offer Me burnt offerings and your food offerings, I will not be pleased. Nor will I regard the peace offerings of your fat animals.

entries.title: Amos 5:23
segments: Take the noise of your songs away from Me; for I will not hear the melody of your stringed instruments.

entries.title: Amos 5:24
segments: But let judgment roll down like waters, and righteousness like a mighty stream.

entries.title: Amos 5:25
segments: Have you offered sacrifices and offerings to Me forty years in the wilderness, O house of Israel?

entries.title: Amos 5:26
segments: But you have carried the booth of your king and Kiyyun, your images, the star of your gods which you made for yourselves.

entries.title: Amos 5:27
segments: So I will cause you to go into exile beyond Damascus, says the LORD, the God of hosts [is] His name.
